violated_contract: A desktop launch must either present its primary SwiftUI scene or report a bounded, actionable failure. A one-shot window lookup in the application delegate can run before SwiftUI mounts the scene, leaving a healthy process with no window and the user stuck at the launching state after a profile reset.
canonical_prevention: Treat the primary scene as eventually mounted: request it idempotently, retry observation for a finite window, and keep the retry cadence and stop condition in a deterministic policy covered by tests. Preserve explicitly headless relaunches as a separate branch so recovery never reopens a window the update policy intentionally suppresses.
